description: Pipeline Trigger Distance (ATCO-023) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ATCO Australia. The Pipeline Trigger Distance is a Buffer Distance based on Maximum Allowable Operating Pressure and the Diameter of the Pipe for risk assessment. This dataset has been requested by the Department of Planning Lands and Heritage. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ATCO Australia. Its tags are Assessment, Buffer, Distance, Risk, Trigger. It offers 21 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Active Acceptance). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
